en: Compress video, photos, and audio without losing memories. All on device.
zh: 压缩视频、照片、音频，不删回忆，全部本地处理。

en: Originals are backed up to the vault before replace. Restore anytime before expiry.
zh: 替换原片前自动备份到保险箱，到期前可随时恢复。

en: Pick files to try, or scan your gallery for the biggest space hogs.
zh: 先选文件体验，或扫描相册找出最占空间的媒体。

en: Scan your library to find files to slim
zh: 扫描相册，找出可瘦身文件

en: Extreme share: smallest size for messaging
zh: 极限分享：体积最小，适合即时通讯

en: High quality archive: best picture for keeping
zh: 高质量存档：画质优先，适合长期保存

zh: 实况 / 动态照片（压静图）

en: Finished files show up here after compression.
zh: 完成压缩后，文件会出现在这里。

en: When you replace originals, backups stay in the vault until you restore or they expire.
zh: 替换原片时，备份会暂存在保险箱，到期前可随时恢复。

en: Scan your gallery and sort by estimated savings.
zh: 扫描相册，按可节省空间排序找出适合压缩的媒体。

en: Record not found or already deleted
zh: 记录不存在或已被删除

en: Only removes the history entry. Original files, outputs, and vault backups stay on device.
zh: 仅删除历史记录，不会删除相册原片、压缩文件或保险箱备份。

zh: 当前文件不能直接改写原片，压缩后会另存为相册新文件。

en: Android will ask for permission before replacing the original.
zh: 替换原片时系统会弹出授权确认。

zh: 原文件无法替换，已另存 %1$d 个新文件到相册

画质优先，适合长期保存
日常均衡，画质与体积兼顾

en: Speech first, for calls and memos

zh: 所选文件已处于最优体积或收益不足，无需进行压缩。

en: View tiered logs, troubleshoot, or export
zh: 查看分级日志、排查问题或导出发送

en: Original will be safely backed up to Vault, restorable for 7 days

en: Keep original; add compressed version as new photo/video
zh: 保留原文件，相册中新增压缩后的文件

en: Log in to sync quota and unlock PRO features
zh: 登录账号以同步云端额度与 PRO 特权

en: Are you sure you want to log out? Local data will remain safe.
zh: 确定要退出登录吗？退出后仅保留本地数据。

en: ✓ Unlimited batch processing for whole library
zh: ✓ 无限批量压缩，全相册后台无忧排队
✓ 4K / 60fps 原画无损画质压缩支持

en: ✓ Unlock HEVC / AV1 / AVIF modern efficient codecs
zh: ✓ 解锁 HEVC / AV1 / AVIF 高效现代编码格式
✓ 原片保险箱 30 天超长保留与无损恢复
✓ 极速多核心多线程并行处理加速

en: Don\'t have an account? Sign up
zh: 没有账号？点击注册新账号

zh: 已有账号？点击立即登录
解锁 PRO 专属特权

en: Free version supports up to %1$d files per batch (selected %2$d). Log in & upgrade to PRO for unlimited batching!
zh: 免费版单次最多支持压缩 %1$d 个文件（当前已选 %2$d 个）。请登录升级 PRO 解锁无限批量！

en: ⚠️ [Critical Warning] This action cannot be undone!
zh: ⚠️ 【极其重要警告】此操作不可撤销！

en:
Emptying the vault will permanently delete all %1$d original backup files (%2$s).

You will NEVER be able to recover these original files! Confirm empty?
zh:
清空保险箱将彻底永久删除全部 %1$d 项原片备份文件（占用 %2$s）。

删除后您将永远无法恢复这些原始文件！请确认是否清空？
已清空保险箱所有原片备份

en: ⚠️ [Warning] Selected %1$d original backups will be permanently deleted!
zh: ⚠️ 【风险提示】即将永久删除已选中的 %1$d 项原片备份！

en: Deleted backups will be completely removed and cannot be restored to your gallery. Continue?
zh: 删除后所选备份将彻底清除，无法重新恢复到系统相册中。请确认是否继续删除？

已成功恢复原文件到相册
需要权限才能恢复原文件

zh: 确认将原片「%1$s」写回系统相册？恢复后可在相册中正常找到原文件。

en: Extend vault retention for \"%1$s\" by 7 days? You will not be reminded to clean it up before expiry.
zh: 确认将「%1$s」在保险箱中的保存期限延长 7 天？到期前不会提醒清理。

en: The original backup of \"%1$s\" will be permanently removed and cannot be recovered! Confirm delete?
zh: 删除后「%1$s」的原片备份将永久移除，无法找回！请确认是否删除？

en: This will remove the compression record for \"%1$s\". Saved files in your gallery remain unaffected.
zh: 删除后将移除「%1$s」的压缩记录。已瘦身并保存到相册的文件不受影响。
确认批量删除历史记录

en: Are you sure you want to delete the selected %1$d history records? This cannot be undone (gallery files unaffected).
zh: 确定要删除选中的 %1$d 条历史记录吗？此操作不可撤销（相册已保存文件不受影响）。

en: Are you sure you want to clear all %1$d completed and failed history records? In-progress and pending jobs will not be deleted.
zh: 确定要清空全部 %1$d 条已完成和失败的历史记录吗？正在进行中及待保存的任务不会被删除。
